function: AES S-box (c = 0) or inverse S-box (c = 1), NIST aes-sbox-sel (FIPS 197)
method_description: direction-select build: one S-box circuit F serves both directions, u = v + c((In+I)v + c_in), w = F(u), y = w + c((Out+I)w + c_out) with In, Out the input and output affine maps that turn F into its inverse; A = A(F) + rank(In+I) + rank(Out+I), AD = AD(F) + 2

start.note: still published; its logs/ give its own start and lineage

chain_root: our published forward circuit aes-sbox-a35-ad3-g141-gd19-xx106-46 (its own logs give its lineage)
lineage: direction-select build (ops/selbuild.py, modes xdelta/leafg, all three rank-8 maps [[31, 0], [95, 0], [174, 0]])
found_utc_source: time of the build's result.json (selbuild.py writes it when the build ends)

first_find.evidence: scan.py of every circuit file in the run folders of these runs and the published circuits: the earliest circuit with this (A, AD, G, GD)

campaign.what: S-box with a direction bit from one forward circuit (ops/selbuild.py: input and output affine maps switched by c around the shared circuit), then kernel polishes of the builds (cli.py run --target aes-sbox-sel)
